summary: Shows the register_secret filter for registering your own strings (inline with register projections), registering lists with map, and validation_action warn or ignore for empty or non-string values.
questions: How do I mask an API token I fetched in a playbook?
How do I register a list of passwords as secrets?
Why does register_secret fail on an empty value?

answer_card.title: Registering your own secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: https://example.com/token
    return_content: true
  register:
    api_token: _task.result.json.token | register_secret
  no_log: true
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Using token {{ api_token }}"   # prints $REDACTED$
```

Lists: `"{{ raw_passwords | map('register_secret') | list }}"`.

Non-strings or empty values raise an error by default; use `register_secret(validation_action='ignore')` or `'warn'`.
